content_zh:
“头好痛，我这是？是死了吗？”意识在黑暗之中，苏醒了起来。
意识开始恢复，记忆如潮水般的迅速涌来。
“我不是被黑龙亚菲特的禁咒魔法“位面空间大转移”给吸聂了进去吗？这又是哪里？”
生机缓缓的在体内回复，丹田之中，一丝极其弱小的真气开始了流动。
黑暗之中的意识轻轻松了一口气，真气还能运转，那就说明自己并没有死亡，只是成了类似植物人的存在。
********
黑暗之中，没有光阴，没有时间，只有绝对的黑暗。
就象一个旁观者一般，安静的看着自己体内真气的运转，一丝丝暗伤也在真气的疗养之中，慢慢的恢复了。
“也许，过不了多久，就能够控制身体了吧。”一声低沉的叹息在黑暗的空间之中响起。
没有时间的概念，黑暗的空间之中，也不知道过了多长的时间。
直到。。。某一天。。
因为意识的慢慢回复，对与体内的情况也更加的了解与透彻。
刚才，对，就是在刚才的那一瞬间，在一股平和中正的真气之中，突的闪耀出了一丝银色的光芒。
这让黑暗之中的意识猛的一跳。
“那是什么？为什么会在我的真气之中？”
可是，自从那一次银色能量闪耀过后，便如同消逝了一般，再也没有出现。
但是，黑暗中的意识并没有放松，他明白那一次的闪现不是错觉，在意识的掌控之下，不管什么都是秋毫必现，绝对不会出现什么错觉。
所以，他在等待，集中全部的意识在等待，只要银色的能量再次出现，必定会被锁定。
时间在消逝，而银色能量却始终没有出现，但，黑暗中的意识并没有出现半点急噪，因为在这封闭黑暗的空间之中，那是他唯一能够取乐的事。
*********

某时某刻。
银色能量终于再次出现，早已经是布满了天罗地网的意识立刻发动了捕获。
搀杂着银色能量那一团真气，迅速消散，将它孤零零的仍在原处。
体内的真气大举出动，在银色能量的外围将之重重包围。
银色能量终于惊慌了起来，开始逃散。
不过面对着不知道有多少层的包围圈，它无路可逃。
包围圈在慢慢的缩小，逐渐的向那死银色能量压迫而去。
终于，第一层的包围圈临近了它，迅速的向它圈去。
显然，这丝银色能量也不是好相易之辈，能量轻轻一震，瞬间消失，然后出现在这层包围圈之外。
“咦。”黑暗中的意识微微惊讶。
又是一圈真气层围了上去。
再闪，再围，再闪。。。。。。
连绵不断的真气层就似没有尽头一般，那丝银色能量宛如磅礴大海之中的一叶小船，被大浪不断的逗戏着。
能量再多也会用光的，没有同种能量的支援的银色能量，慢慢的显露了疲态，终于一个疏忽，被一圈真气牢牢捆住，后面无数的真气随之绕动，将那丝银色能量圈成一团能量球。
意识转动，一丝真气慢慢的侵噬着那股银色能量。
不断的分解着它的特性。
一阵活泼，闪动而又神秘的味道出现在黑暗的意识之中。
“这是？？这就是号称最接近神灵的力量？？空间能量？？”疑惑从意识之中淡淡的散发。
吞噬了银色能量的真气，此刻发生了异变。
原本白色的真气在吞噬了空间能量之后，慢慢的变成了银白之色。

一抹意念慢慢的控制住这丝变异了的能量，慢慢的开始了探察，若是变异了之后的能量，对自己有益的话，那就随之转换，若是有害。。。那便就只有让它消散了。
随着意念的探察，也慢慢的对这丝能量也了了解。
原来，自己在中了“位面空间大转移”之后，被传送进了一神秘的空间，就是在其中，一掠银色的能量进入了自己的体内。
新生的变异真气很强，很大。
既有真气的纯和中正，又隐有空间能量的诡异与神秘，貌似对自己没什么坏处？
既然没坏处，那就都转换了吧。
庞大的真气在慢慢的转换，或许是因为转换了之后的能量在品质上要高上一些吧。
原本庞大的真气在经过转换之后，细小了许多，但是却更加的凝结了许多。
黑暗的空间之中，传出一股满意的信息。

content_en:
"My head hurts. What am I doing? Am I dead?" His consciousness woke up in the darkness.
Consciousness began to return, and memories came flooding in quickly.
"Wasn't I sucked in by the black dragon Yaphet's forbidden spell magic "Great Plane Space Shift"? Where is this?"
The vitality slowly returned to the body, and an extremely weak trace of true energy began to flow in the Dantian.
The consciousness in the darkness breathed a sigh of relief, and his true energy could still circulate, which meant that he had not died, but had become something like a vegetative state.
**********
In the darkness, there is no time, no time, only absolute darkness.
Just like a bystander, quietly watching the movement of the true energy in his body, all traces of hidden wounds are slowly recovering in the healing process of the true energy.
"Perhaps, it won't be long before I can control my body." A low sigh sounded in the dark space.
There is no concept of time, and in the dark space, no one knows how much time has passed.
until. . . One day. .
As consciousness slowly returns, I have a better understanding and thoroughness of the situation inside my body.
Just now, yes, at that moment just now, in a wave of peaceful and upright energy, a silvery light suddenly shone.
This made the consciousness in the darkness jump sharply.
"What is that? Why is it in my Qi?"
However, ever since that flash of silver energy, it seemed to have disappeared and never appeared again.
However, his consciousness in the darkness did not relax. He understood that the flash of light was not an illusion. Under the control of his consciousness, everything would appear, and there would never be any illusion.
Therefore, he is waiting, concentrating all his consciousness on waiting. As long as the silver energy appears again, it will definitely be locked.
Time was passing, but the silver energy never appeared. However, the consciousness in the darkness did not make any noise, because in this closed dark space, that was the only thing he could have fun with.
*********
At some point.
The silver energy finally appeared again, and the consciousness that had already been covered with dragnets immediately started to capture it.
The ball of true energy mixed with silver energy quickly dissipated, leaving it alone in its place.
The true energy in the body was mobilized in a large scale, surrounding it heavily on the outside of the silver energy.
The silver energy finally panicked and began to flee.
But faced with an unknown number of layers of encirclement, it had no way to escape.
The surrounding circle is slowly shrinking, gradually pressing towards the dead silver energy.
Finally, the first level of encirclement approached it and quickly circled towards it.
Obviously, this silver energy is not easy to exchange. The energy shook slightly, disappeared instantly, and then appeared outside this surrounding circle.
"Huh." The consciousness in the darkness was slightly surprised.
Another circle of infuriating energy surrounded him.
Dodge again, surround again, and dodge again. . . . . .
The continuous zhenqi layer seems to have no end, and the silver energy is like a small boat in the majestic sea, being constantly teased by the big waves.
No matter how much energy there is, it will be used up. The silver energy without the support of the same energy slowly showed its fatigue. Finally, due to an oversight, it was tightly bound by a circle of true energy. Countless true energy followed and circled the silver energy into an energy ball.
His consciousness turned, and a trace of true energy slowly invaded the silver energy.
Constantly decomposing its characteristics.
A lively, flashing and mysterious flavor appeared in the dark consciousness.
"This?? This is the power that is said to be closest to the gods?? Space energy??" Doubts emanated faintly from consciousness.
The zhenqi that swallowed up the silver energy changed at this moment.
The originally white zhenqi slowly turned into a silvery white color after swallowing up the space energy.A touch of thought slowly controlled this mutated energy, and slowly began to explore. If the mutated energy is beneficial to itself, then it will be converted accordingly. If it is harmful, it will be converted. . . Then just let it dissipate.
With the exploration of his thoughts, he gradually understood this energy.
It turned out that after being hit by the "Great Plane Space Shift", he was transported into a mysterious space, where a flash of silver energy entered his body.
The newly mutated Qi is very strong and very large.
It has the purity and righteousness of true energy, but also contains the weirdness and mystery of space energy. Doesn't it seem to do any harm to you?
Since there is no harm, let’s convert them all.
The huge amount of zhenqi is slowly converting, perhaps because the quality of the converted energy is higher.
The originally huge zhenqi became much smaller after the transformation, but it became more condensed.
In the dark space, a message of satisfaction came out.
